title: 10 Best Owner Statement Software for Vacation Rental Managers
summary: Compare 10 ways to build vacation rental owner statements, from Topkey and Guesty to Hostaway, Hospitable, OwnerRez and the spreadsheet template.
body_markdown:
*Updated November 2026*


"What's this $340 charge?"


Every vacation rental manager knows that email. It shows up a day or two after statements go out. Then someone on your team digs through card statements, texts and receipts to figure out what the charge was and prove it was legitimate.


The owner statement is the one report every owner reads. It's how they decide whether you're worth your fee. Most statement problems come from the same few places: expenses that never made it onto the statement, receipts nobody can find, and commission math done by hand.


This guide compares 10 ways to build owner statements: tools that work across PMSs, statements built into a PMS, and the spreadsheet many teams start with. After Topkey, the numbers are just reading order.


## The 10 Options at a Glance


Option Type Best for


Topkey Works with your PMS Receipt-backed statements, sent and paid from one list


VRPlatform STR ledger Statements built on an STR-specific general ledger


Guesty Inside a PMS Guesty users who want annual statements too


Hostaway Inside a PMS Hostaway users who want scheduled statements


Hospitable Inside a PMS Statements and payouts in one place


OwnerRez Inside a PMS Owner and manager statements side by side


Hostfully Inside a PMS A branded, multilingual owner portal


Track Inside a PMS Complex owner tax situations


Escapia Inside a PMS Large managers on an all-in-one PMS


Spreadsheets Manual workaround A handful of owners with simple contracts


## How We Picked and Checked These Tools


Each option builds owner statements for vacation rental managers and gives owners a way to receive them. For every one, we looked at four things: how it handles stays and commission, expenses and receipts, the owner portal, and paying owners.


We checked those features on each vendor's own website on November 24 and 25, 2026. Pricing isn't included, since it changes too often to stay accurate.


## What Owners Look for in a Statement


Owners want every stay and every fee, and they want it to match the contract they signed. If your commission math is off by a few dollars, they'll notice, and they'll start checking every line.


They want proof behind every expense. An expense with a receipt attached rarely gets questioned. An expense without one becomes an email, and sometimes an argument.


And they want it on time, in a place they can find it, followed by their money. A statement that's late, or a payout that lags, does more damage than almost any single charge.


## Built to Work With Your PMS


These two aren't tied to a single PMS. Topkey builds statements on top of the PMS you already use. VRPlatform builds them on its own general ledger.


### 1. Topkey


Topkey is the AI-powered financial operating system built specifically for vacation rental managers. It turns your PMS reservations and receipt-backed owner expenses into owner statements you can review, send and pay from one place.


**How it handles owner statements.**[Topkey's owner statements](https://topkey.io/owner-statements) are drafted from PMS reservations and the owner expenses your team tracks in Topkey. Card charges and bills tagged to an owner land on the statement with the receipt linked, answering "what's this charge?" before it's asked.


Commission is figured per stay from each owner's contract, statements run from opening balance to amount owed, and negative balances carry forward. Your team approves drafts before owners see anything.


Owners get a PDF and a portal login, and every owner is paid in bulk from one list. It works with Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, OwnerRez, Track and Hospitable.


It also catches the owner charges that usually go missing. Markups apply to owner charges and inventory checkouts, and completed Breezeway tasks flow in so billable field work gets billed. Statements show owner cash and reserves, can list every expense or one total per property, and are checked against the trust ledger.


**Where Topkey isn't the right fit.** If you only manage properties you own, there's no one to send a statement to, so this part of Topkey won't apply. Your PMS reports are likely enough.


**Best for:** managers on those six PMSs whose statements stall on missing receipts and owner charges, from small teams to large ones that want review, send and pay in one place.


[Visit Topkey](https://topkey.io/owner-statements)


### 2. VRPlatform (VRTrust)


VRPlatform's VRTrust is short-term rental accounting software with owner statements built on its own general ledger.


**What it does well.** VRTrust builds owner statements with commissions, expenses and adjustments included, and tracks owner balances as it goes. Statements are customizable, owners get a portal, and you can pay owners with one-click ACH.


**Where it falls short.** You get these statements by moving your books onto VRTrust's ledger. If you only want better statements, that's a much bigger change than you need.


**Best for:** managers already planning to move to an STR-specific ledger.


[Visit VRPlatform](https://www.vrplatform.app/features/owner-statement-software-vacation-rentals)


## Owner Statements Inside Your PMS


Most vacation rental PMSs can build owner statements. The difference is how much they handle beyond the statement itself, like expenses, receipts and paying owners.


### 3. Guesty


Guesty is a vacation rental PMS whose accounting module includes owner statements.


**What it does well.** Guesty builds customizable owner statements, plus annual statements that you can run for one owner, a group or your whole portfolio. Owners get a portal, and the payouts can go out from Guesty too.


**Where it falls short.** Statements only work if Guesty is your PMS. They're also only as complete as the expenses your team enters in Guesty.


**Best for:** Guesty users who want monthly and annual statements in one place.


[Visit Guesty](https://www.guesty.com/features/accounting/)


### 4. Hostaway


Hostaway is a vacation rental PMS for managers with 5 to 500+ properties.


**What it does well.** Hostaway generates, customizes and sends monthly owner statements. An Auto-statements tab runs them on a schedule, and bulk actions handle many at once. In the owner portal, you choose which modules each owner sees, and there's a mobile owner experience too.


**Where it falls short.** Hostaway says payouts follow the manager's own accounting setup. So the statement tells owners what they're owed, but paying them happens somewhere else.


**Best for:** Hostaway users who want statements to run on a schedule.


[Visit Hostaway](https://www.hostaway.com/features/owner-statement/)


### 5. Hospitable


Hospitable is a vacation rental platform for everyone from single-property hosts to portfolios of 1,000.


**What it does well.** Monthly statements generate from live reservations, with commission, fee and tax structures you set per owner. Payouts go straight to owners' bank accounts. Owners get a portal with your branding, and Owner Payments lets you invoice owners who owe you money.


**Where it falls short.** It works best when Hospitable runs your whole operation. Teams that keep their accounting and expenses in other systems will still be moving data between them.


**Best for:** managers who want statements and payouts in the same platform.


[Visit Hospitable](https://hospitable.com/features/owner-portal-statements)


### 6. OwnerRez


OwnerRez is a vacation rental PMS with owner statements built in.


**What it does well.** OwnerRez produces owner statements and property manager statements side by side. Payout statements show money moving from escrow to the right party, and owners get portal access.


**Where it falls short.** Statements draw on what's recorded in OwnerRez. Expenses paid on company cards or tracked in another tool have to be entered before they show up.


**Best for:** OwnerRez users who want owner and manager statements together.


[Visit OwnerRez](https://www.ownerrez.com/property-management)


### 7. Hostfully


Hostfully is a vacation rental PMS with owner management tools.


**What it does well.** Hostfully's owner portal is branded, multilingual and permission-based. Owners see their financial statements, bookings and owner stays. You can track owner charges and deductions and share customized statements to the portal.


**Where it falls short.** It's a Hostfully feature, so it only helps if Hostfully is your PMS. Switching PMS just to get a nicer owner portal is rarely worth it on its own.


**Best for:** Hostfully users with owners who want a polished portal.


[Visit Hostfully](https://www.hostfully.com/property-management-platform/features/owner-management/)


### 8. Track


Track is an enterprise PMS for larger vacation rental companies.


**What it does well.** Track can send statements weekly instead of only monthly, which helps with owners who like a closer look. Statements come straight off its trust ledger, and tricky owner tax situations, including foreign owners subject to IRS withholding, are handled in the system.


**Where it falls short.** It's part of an enterprise PMS. For a team that only wants better statements, it's a big system to adopt.


**Best for:** larger managers with complex owner tax situations.


[Visit Track](https://trackhs.com/product/trust-accounting/)


### 9. Escapia


Escapia is the vacation rental PMS from Expedia Group, the company behind Vrbo.


**What it does well.** Escapia calls its owner portal the most comprehensive on the market. Owner reporting sits in the same system as reservations and trust accounting.


**Where it falls short.** Getting Escapia's owner reporting means moving to Escapia for everything else too.


**Best for:** large managers who want owner reporting in an all-in-one PMS.


[Visit Escapia](https://www.escapia.com/vacation-rental-property-management-software/)


## The Manual Workaround


### 10. Spreadsheets


Many teams start with a spreadsheet template and a monthly copy and paste from the PMS.


**What it does well.** It's free and you can lay it out however you like. If you need one, Topkey has a[free owner statement template](https://www.topkey.io/free-owner-statement-template) .


**Where it falls short.** Every number is typed or pasted, so one wrong cell can send an owner the wrong amount. There's no portal, and receipts live in a separate folder, if anyone saved them.


**Best for:** a handful of owners with simple contracts.


## The Bottom Line


If your PMS builds statements you're happy with, keep using it. The gaps usually show up around the statement: expenses without receipts, and paying owners in a separate system. Topkey earns the top spot by closing both gaps across six PMSs, with receipts linked on every statement and every owner paid from one list.


[See Topkey's owner statements](https://topkey.io/owner-statements)


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What should a vacation rental owner statement include?


A good owner statement shows the opening balance, every stay and its revenue, fees and commission, every owner expense with its receipt, any reserve held, and the amount owed to the owner. It should match the owner's management contract line for line.


### How often should owner statements go out?


Most vacation rental managers send owner statements monthly. Some tools, like Track, also support weekly statements, and Guesty can produce annual statements for tax time.


### What is an owner portal?


An owner portal is a login where property owners can view their statements, bookings and performance without emailing you. Topkey, Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Hostfully and Escapia all offer one.


### Can my PMS create owner statements?


Most vacation rental PMSs can, including Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Hostfully, Track and Escapia. What varies is how they handle expenses, receipts and paying owners.


### How do I stop owners from questioning expenses?


Attach the receipt to every owner expense on the statement. Topkey links receipts on PDF statements for expenses tagged to an owner, so the proof travels with the charge.


### Can I pay owners from the same software?


Some tools do both. Topkey lets you approve, send and pay every owner in bulk from one list. Guesty, Hospitable and VRPlatform also pay owners. Hostaway says payouts follow your own accounting setup.
